code.publication_mode: Ordinary fast-forward commits; no history rewrite

fresh_github_checkout_tests.environment: Existing verified Python 3.12 environment; package imported from the fresh checkout, not from the original workspace

application.interface: Loopback audio upload, artifact selection, probability, measurements, contribution explanations and JSON export
application.bc: Optional research measurement; never included in probability

retention.runtime_policy: Keep the application environment and explicit analysis-model cache needed by S/D/R/P; no music-generation models or raw audio in the public codebase

limitations: Four MP3 source bytes match but strict decoded waveform/feature replay does not; all 56 sampled combination decisions were unchanged.
CPU/GPU precision and the historical unseeded Demucs shifts change fresh neural values; no bitwise neural replay or new-platform external calibration claim.
Probabilities are retrospective internal reference-mixture calibration, not universal authorship confidence or unknown-generator accuracy.
The observed human-labelled MAESTRO false positive is retained in the report and tests.
Native60 report reproduction aggregates frozen predictions; it does not rerun whole-corpus audio inference.
Research/source-specific licensing still applies; private retention does not grant redistribution rights.
